sp_login.title: Link SP Services account
sp_login.description:
SP Services requires a captcha and SMS OTP, so log in with your browser:

1. Open this link and sign in: {authorize_url}
2. Complete the captcha and OTP.
3. When the browser reaches `services.spservices.sg/callback?...`, copy the full URL (use the browser's Network tab with 'Preserve log' if it redirects too fast).
4. Paste it below — it must contain both `code=` and `state=`.

If SP does not issue a refresh token for your account, the next step offers a way to keep the session alive.

sp_account.title: Choose SP Services account
sp_account.description: Several utility accounts are linked to this login. Pick the one to track.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-link SP Services account
reauth_confirm.description:
The SP Services session expired. Log in again with your browser:

1. Open this link and sign in: {authorize_url}
2. Complete the captcha and OTP.
3. Copy the full `services.spservices.sg/callback?...` URL.
4. Paste it below — it must contain both `code=` and `state=`.

sp_session.title: Keep the SP Services session alive
sp_session.description:
SP did not issue a refresh token for this account, so the sign-in above expires on its own. Home Assistant can renew it the same way the SP web portal does — with your Auth0 session cookie:

1. In the browser you just signed in with, open developer tools (F12) → **Application** (Chrome/Edge) or **Storage** (Firefox) → **Cookies** → `https://identity.spdigital.auth0.com`.
2. Copy the **Value** of the cookie named `auth0`.
3. Paste it below.

The cookie is stored in Home Assistant and refreshed automatically on every renewal, so the link lasts until SP ends the session (typically weeks). Leave the field empty to skip — usage still works, but you will be asked to sign in again when the access token expires.

error.name_too_long: Name must be 64 characters or fewer.
error.invalid_callback: That callback URL did not contain a valid authorization code for this login attempt. Open the new link below and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SP Services. Try again in a moment.
error.no_accounts: This SP Services login has no linked utility accounts.
error.invalid_session_cookie: SP would not renew a session with that cookie. Copy the `auth0` cookie value again from the browser you signed in with, or leave the field empty to skip.

abort.reauth_successful: The SP Services account was re-linked.
